title: Purair® FUMEBOX™ - Portable Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber
meta_title: Purair FUMEBOX - Portable Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber | Air Science
meta_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable cyanoacrylate fuming chamber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, and powders during low-volume forensic processing.
meta_keywords: cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, portable fume hood, forensic equipment, evidence processing, air purification
short_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is designed to protect the user from chemicals, vapors or non-toxic powders during low-volume chemical manipulations by effectively containing low concentrations of noxious fumes, vapors, or powders.
full_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable cyanoacrylate fuming chamber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, and powders during low-volume forensic processing. With a clear viewing enclosure, the FUMEBOX prevents chemical splash while allowing full visibility. Its modular design permits multiple configurations to fit a variety of workspace requirements.
seo_content: The FUMEBOX features a low-profile design that is completely portable and requires no ductwork. Its compact size allows easy placement on shallow countertops or under cabinets. The FUMEBOX is constructed with epoxy-coated steel for durability and chemical resistance, and meets all relevant OSHA and ISO standards for laboratory equipment. Available accessories include a fume extraction unit and spill tray to further enhance safety and containment.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.

page_content_sections.overview: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable cyanoacrylate fuming chamber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, and powders during low-volume forensic processing.
page_content_sections.specifications: The FUMEBOX is constructed with epoxy-coated steel and meets all relevant OSHA and ISO standards for laboratory equipment. It features a low-profile, completely portable design that requires no ductwork.
page_content_sections.applications: The FUMEBOX is used for cyanoacrylate fuming, forensic evidence processing, crime scene investigation, histology and pathology sample preparation, graphic arts, and electronics assembly.
page_content_sections.models: The FUMEBOX is available in three models: AP60H-A (horizontal, 21" width), AP60V-A (vertical, 21" width), and AP60H-XL-A (horizontal, 30" width).
